data.summary:
Transformation-focused Process Improvement Leader with decade of experience orchestrating large-scale digital transformation programs in global retail and commercial banking. Proven track record managing end-to-end delivery of customer onboarding, digital platform migration, and online banking initiatives across EMEA and US markets. Expert at translating complex regulatory requirements into scalable implementation roadmaps, embedding control frameworks, and driving cross-functional alignment between Compliance, Operations, Technology, and Business stakeholders. Advanced proficiency in Agile delivery methodologies, Jira/Confluence project management, and governance frameworks. Demonstrated track record managing complex, regulated environments while maintaining audit readiness and internal control standards.
Strategic communicator skilled at converting complex process and risk insights into simple, compelling narratives that influence senior decision-makers and drive adoption of change. Data-driven strategist with hands-on experience designing dashboards, KPIs, and analytical models to identify inefficiencies, quantify impact, and prioritize transformation initiatives. Innovation-focused leader with experience evaluating and implementing automation, RPA, and emerging AI-enabled solutions to optimize processes and reduce operational risk. Proven expertise in end-to-end transaction lifecycle management, due diligence oversight, and multistakeholder coordination encompassing Compliance, Legal, Credit, and Risk domains. Accomplished in leading large cross-functional teams, instituting governance frameworks, and embedding data-driven control mechanisms to ensure transparency, quality, and audit readiness. Proficient at designing and executing process re-engineering initiatives leveraging automation tools such as Alteryx, Python, and UiPath, resulting in measurable efficiency gains and scalability. Experienced in managing strategic programs aligned with business transformation, operational resilience, and digital innovation goals using Agile and Scrum methodologies. Showcased strong organizational leadership and influence as Employee Representative and ACE Impact Chair at BNY Mellon Poland, driving inclusion, engagement, and culture-building initiatives. Recognized for fostering high-performing, inclusive teams through structured capability development, continuous coaching, and performance enablement aligned with organizational vision. Work
